scope: Certified 2023-only strict-prior batter features, fixed CatBoost core, four chronological OOF folds. This is attribution, not a causal claim or model selection.

measured_findings.hr: Removing the strict-prior batted-ball block worsened Brier by +0.00003235 (95% [+0.00001629, +0.00004910]) and log loss by +0.000274996 (95% [+0.00015919, +0.00039939]) versus the full core, with aggregate AUC loss. AUC loss was not present in every fold, so this is a valid source-block priority, not proof of a new candidate.
measured_findings.hits_and_total_bases: Removing strict-prior pitch-shape features worsened both Brier and log loss with positive 95% lower bounds for Hits and Total Bases. Total Bases also lost AUC in every fold; Hits did not. This is a valid source-block priority, not a production change.
measured_findings.outcome_history: Removing outcome-history features had mixed or slightly improved proper scores. This does not justify deleting them: the audit is diagnostic and cannot establish a causal redundancy or a better model specification.

rejected_interpretations: The report does not prove a causal mechanism.
The report does not prove a data defect.
The report does not authorize removal of any block, coefficient tuning, a new fitted candidate, a 2024 read, a 2025 HR-confirmation read, or betting.
single_highest_value_next_action: Conduct a predeclared source-to-feature lineage and denominator audit of the batted-ball block (HR priority) and pitch-shape block (Hits/Total Bases priority), tracing raw strict-prior rows through the panel and testing timing, identity, unit, count, and serialization mutations before considering any new candidate.
